account.limit_verification: Not returned by usage API; requires account-specific evidence before pair admission

pair_reservation.basis: Two times the largest saved pilot Run repriced at accepted peak rates with no cache discount; a prospective planning reservation, not a cap or future upper bound.
pair_reservation.horizon_definition: Two existing 1800-second generation budgets plus one hour of operational allowance; an admission forecast, not a new Run timeout.
pair_reservation.adoption: Proposed before outcomes; reverify applicable prices and accept with execution freeze. No scientific Run cap introduced.

storage.definition: Pilot-based reservation only. All raw originals retained. At most one pair is staged/downloaded/restored at once. Four-Run retained cohort divided by two estimates a pair, including historical archive duplication; two copies of the largest Run directory provision scratch. Native-state snapshot growth and future tails remain unbounded.
storage.docker_storage_observed: Docker WSL data and main VHDX files are on C:; no container was started.

record.after_unexpected_limit_or_storage_failur: Stop new dispatch. Preserve partial/uncertain slots. Re-read account and reconcile actual dispatch before continuation; no replacement, new pair, model fallback, purchase or account rotation.

decision.reservation_risk: Pilot-based demand can be exceeded. Pause on quota/storage failure, preserve partial and uncertain slots, never replace or switch models.
